## Wells Fargo (WFC) Net Interest Margin (NIM)

The most recent figure is **Q2 2026: ~2.43%**, down from the prior quarter and the year-earlier period, and slightly below analyst estimates. This decline (revenue and EPS beat, but NIM miss) contributed to WFC shares falling ~2.7% on the July 14, 2026 earnings day.

**Recent trend (taxable-equivalent basis):**

| Period | NIM |
|---|---|
| FY 2025 (full year) | 2.64% |
| Q4 2025 | ~2.6% |
| Q3 2025 | 2.61% |
| Q2 2026 | 2.43% |

**Context:**
- Management attributed Q2 2026 NIM compression to *deliberate* balance-sheet growth in lower-spread market financing and interest-bearing deposits, rather than external market pressures.
- Despite the NIM decline, net interest income (NII) rose 5.2% YoY to $12.32 billion on lower deposit costs, higher loan/investment securities balances, and Markets balance-sheet growth.
- Wells Fargo maintained its full-year 2026 NII guidance of ~$50 billion (expecting growth driven by loan and securities balances, with margin compression anticipated in Q2).
- Over the past two years, the NIM has averaged around 2.6% — the long-term drift down reflects balance-sheet mix shifts and rate dynamics.

**Sources:**
- [Earnings Preview: What To Expect From Wells Fargo's Report (Yahoo Finance)](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/earnings-preview-expect-wells-fargos-134303390.html)
- [Wells Fargo Q2 Earnings Beat on NII & Fee Income Growth (Zacks/Yahoo Finance)](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/wells-fargo-q2-earnings-beat-170700685.html)
- [Wells Fargo 3Q25 Presentation (Wells Fargo IR)](https://www.wellsfargo.com/assets/pdf/about/investor-relations/earnings/third-quarter-2025-presentation.pdf)
- [Wells Fargo 2025 Annual Report (Wells Fargo IR)](https://www.wellsfargo.com/assets/pdf/about/investor-relations/annual-reports/2025-annual-report.pdf)
- [Wells Fargo (WFC): Buy, Sell, or Hold Post Q2 Earnings? (Yahoo Finance)](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/wells-fargo-wfc-buy-sell-192347412.html)

Note: the "Q2 2026" figures come from sources dated into 2026; if you're looking for a specific reporting period, let me know and I can pull the exact filing.
